name: Diagonal Wipe
description: A soft diagonal wipe that sweeps from one corner of the frame to the opposite one. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: corner
params.description: The corner where the first clip is last seen: 0 = top-left (xfade diagtl), 1 = top-right (diagtr), 2 = bottom-left (diagbl), 3 = bottom-right (diagbr)
